replacements.new:
中文：短句，每句不超过约 50 字；动词直接用（检查、决定，而不是进行检查、做出决定）；一句话里的“的”不超过两个；数字后写清边界（超过 3 次、不超过 1 秒）；用具体结果代替套话（赋能、全方位、至关重要）。

For Chinese: use short sentences of no more than about 50 characters. Use verbs directly (检查, 决定: check, decide), rather than light-verb phrases (进行检查, 做出决定). Use no more than two instances of 的 in one sentence. State numeric bounds explicitly (超过 3 次: more than 3 times; 不超过 1 秒: no more than 1 second). Replace stock phrases (赋能, 全方位, 至关重要: empower, comprehensive, crucial) with concrete results.
